idea-plugin.name: Moe's Tavern
idea-plugin.description:
Moe's Tavern — an AI agent task board for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build.

Run your coding agents as a team with distinct roles through a shared Kanban board, with human plan approval before any code is written.

Features

  • Kanban board — 5 columns (Backlog, Planning, Working, Review, Done); plans awaiting approval show in Planning, blocked tasks stay in Working with a badge
  • Plan approval — review each implementation plan before implementation in the default CONTROL mode; SPEED and TURBO relax the gate
  • Roles — architect plans, worker implements step by step and records verification, QA reviews against the Definition of Done, governor oversees the fleet
  • Your choice of CLI — launch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Grok Build per role from the Agents menu
  • Coordination — teams, task dependencies, shared resources, and chat channels with @mentions
  • Git tied to tasks — agent launchers land task-linked commits and checkpoints on every exit, with rescue refs for interrupted work
  • Rails and skills — project rules agents must follow, plus bundled skills for planning, testing, debugging and review
  • Real-time sync — live board updates over WebSocket from the local daemon; drag and drop to change status

How it works

  1. Create epics and tasks on the board
  2. An architect claims a task and submits an implementation plan
  3. You approve or reject the plan
  4. A worker implements the approved steps and records verification
  5. QA reviews the result and approves it or sends it back

The plugin bundles the Moe daemon and MCP proxy; project state lives in .moe/ inside your repository. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux. Requires Node.js and at least one of the supported coding CLIs.

Documentation and source code
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.8.0

  • Headless Codex launch fixed for codex-cli 0.147 and later
  • Headless Codex seats run with full access by default and pre-approve the Moe and Serena MCP servers: codex 0.148 and later rejected every Moe tool call under a sandbox, and the Windows sandbox could not start a Store-installed PowerShell 7
  • Bash Codex seats get a private per-seat instructions file, like the PowerShell launcher
  • Codex seats are interactive by default; -CodexExec opts a seat into one-shot headless exec
  • Grok Build (xAI) supported as an agent CLI
  • Land on every exit: task-linked completion and checkpoint commits, with rescue refs when landing fails
  • Task dependencies with automatic unblock when prerequisites finish
  • Shared resources: daemon-managed exclusive leases for infrastructure such as a staging database

0.6.0 and 0.7.0: see GitHub releases.
